title: list_sxablonoj input
description: Every Sxablono of the served Modelo (Spec 020): the patterns of Eroj — the frame of an application, a page — with their kind and their regions; list_eroj lists the Eroj. With lingvo, every Sxablono names its display name as label beside its name (Spec 026 ②).

lingvo.description: The language of the display names (Spec 026 ②): every entry names its label beside its name.
